entries.title: Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia
entries.summary: OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West.

entries.title: Advancing price-performance for developers with GPT‑5.6 in Kiro
entries.summary: GPT‑5.6 is now available in Kiro, helping developers plan, build, review, and test software with better price-performance.

entries.title: Introducing AI Futures
entries.summary: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.

entries.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
entries.summary: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.

entries.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
entries.summary: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

entries.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
entries.summary: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs.

entries.title: ChatGPT Ads expands across Europe
entries.summary: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 31 European markets. Learn how advertisers can reach people as they explore, compare options, and make decisions.

entries.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
entries.summary: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.
